quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: You must pull over for an emergency vehicle:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights. This applies whether the vehicle is behind you or coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: You must yield to emergency vehicles:

options.text: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.
Only when other vehicles yield first.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.
questions.explanation: You must give the right-of-way to emergency vehicles using flashing lights or sirens.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign is a:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are usually yellow with black markings. Orange diamond signs appear in work areas. These signs warn you about hazards or areas with special rules ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: If you get stranded in a snowstorm, you should:

options.text: Leave the car and walk for help.
Lie down and sleep in your car.
Walk onto the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in your car. It is easier for rescuers to find you there.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car. It is easier for rescuers to find you there.
questions.explanation: Stay in your vehicle if you are stranded in a snowstorm. Rescuers will find you more easily if you stay put. Walking in a snowstorm can be dangerous.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Be ready for people crossing the street.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: Bigger vehicles have bigger blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the back that cannot be seen in side or rearview mirrors.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the median or divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: Is it legal to drive while holding your pet on your lap?

options.text: Yes, if the animal is asleep.
Yes, but it is not recommended.

questions.explanation: Holding an animal on your lap while driving is dangerous and illegal. If you cause a moving violation while doing this, you may face distracted driving charges in addition to other penalties.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can drive when it is safe.

questions.question: When can you cross a dashed white line?

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross them to change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive when turning onto a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red light at an intersection, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop first, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop first, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Then proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: How can you prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal and let your vehicle slow before braking.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to avoid hitting your vehicle. Release the gas pedal first to let your car slow down. Then press the brake pedal smoothly to stop safely and alert drivers behind you with your brake lights.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road conditions that may be unexpected or hard to see.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your reflexes and judgment?

options.text: Less if you drink beer instead of wine.
Less if you drink wine instead of beer.
Most when drinking hard ciders and mixed drinks.
It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: All types of alcohol harm your reflexes and judgment the same way. What matters is how much alcohol is in your bloodstream, not the type.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is open.
If no right lane is open, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce your speed to let the tailgater pass.

questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, move right if there is an open lane. If not, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce your speed to encourage them to pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. This sign warns you that maintenance work is ahead. Reduce your speed and drive with caution through the work area.

questions.question: What must a driver do when dealing with pedestrians?

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian sees your vehicle.
Always give them the right-of-way, even if they are wrong.
Only give them the right-of-way when they are legally allowed to cross.
Slow down and honk near a crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always give them the right-of-way, even if they are wrong.
questions.explanation: You must do everything possible to avoid hitting a pedestrian. Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are crossing where they should not be.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you are sure no train is coming.
Turn down your radio to listen for an approaching train.
Only proceed when a flagger tells you it is safe.

questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution. Only cross when you are certain no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, obey their instructions. Lower your radio volume to listen for trains.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly through the intersection.
You must stop and then go when the way is clear.
You must stop and then go when the signal turns green or shows a green arrow.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop and then go when the signal turns green or shows a green arrow.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must come to a complete stop and stay stopped until the signal changes to green or shows a green arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, what should you do?

options.text: You may turn, but you must let oncoming traffic go first.
You must go straight and cannot turn.
You still have the right to turn.
You no longer need to turn in the direction the arrow showed.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn, but you must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, you may still turn in that direction. However, you must first let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Another road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Another road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection is ahead and a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare drivers for road conditions. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for red or yellow lights and watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: When may you go through a stop sign intersection that has no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for other traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and making sure it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and making sure it is safe.
questions.explanation: Stop before entering the intersection at a stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: At night, when another vehicle is coming toward you, your headlights should:

options.text: Be on the high beam setting.
Be on the low beam setting.
Be off and use parking lights instead.
Be on either high or low beam.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be on the low beam setting.
questions.explanation: Do not use high beams when another vehicle is coming toward you or when you are following another vehicle. Use low beams to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: Child restraints are required for which children?

options.text: Children under age 4 and/or weighing less than 40 pounds.
All children if the driver is their parent or guardian.
All children sitting in the front seat.
All children under age 6 when airbags are not available.

questions.correctAnswerText: Children under age 4 and/or weighing less than 40 pounds.
questions.explanation: Children under age 4 and/or weighing less than 40 pounds must use an approved child safety seat. Children age 4 to 8 and under 4'9" tall must use a booster seat.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. This sign means U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in a residential area if no other sign is posted?
questions.explanation: The default speed limit in residential areas is 25 miles per hour unless a different speed limit sign is posted.
